latest_release.name: v2.8.4
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(roles): degrade instead of 500 when the roles header is absent by @azuretek in https://github.com/linuxserver/Heimdall/pull/1605
* fix(roles): gate the sidenav pin list and #add-item on the admin role by @azuretek in https://github.com/linuxserver/Heimdall/pull/1603
* fix: register the register:app artisan command reliably by @KodeStar in https://github.com/linuxserver/Heimdall/pull/1607
* Accept SVG item icon uploads again by @KodeStar in https://github.com/linuxserver/Heimdall/pull/1612
* Update dependencies to fix composer audit advisories by @KodeStar in https://github.com/linuxserver/Heimdall/pull/1619
* Bump version to 2.8.4 by @KodeStar in https://github.com/linuxserver/Heimdall/pull/1608

## New Contributors
* @azuretek made their first contribution in https://github.com/linuxserver/Heimdall/pull/1605

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/linuxserver/Heimdall/compare/v2.8.3...v2.8.4
